# Database schema

<!-- Generated by `npm run schema:doc` from api/_lib/schemas. Do not edit by hand. -->

The database is MongoDB, reached through the Firestore-shaped adapter in `api/_lib/mongoFirestore.ts`. There are **107 collections**. This file lists each one with the fields its schema names. Schemas are `strict: false`: other fields may exist and are kept.

Conventions: the document id is stored as `_id` (a string) and is not a field below; many documents also copy it as `id`. Dates are ISO-8601 strings (`YYYY-MM-DD` or full timestamps). Every tenant-owned record has `companyId`. Fields marked *required* are checked on full writes (see `SCHEMA_VALIDATION` in the README).
